before.jp: みんなで騒いで楽しかった

structure_explanation.en: The sentence chains two ideas with the て-form of the verb: 騒いで ('to make a commotion', in the linking form, from 騒ぐ, the target 1139) links to the adjective in the past 楽しかった ('it was fun'). みんなで means 'all together / as a group', with で marking the set that performs the action. The tone is casual (without です/ます).

O tom é casual (sem です/ます).

ops.issue: lit_pt uses the topic device 'Quanto a...' but お祝い is a を-marked direct object, not a は topic; it misrepresents the structure and contradicts lit_en ('I will send the wedding gift'), which correctly has no topic phrasing.

before.jp: 結婚のお祝いを送ります
before.kana: けっこんのおいわいをおくります

structure_explanation.en: The structure is [object] を [verb]: 結婚のお祝い (wedding gift) is the direct object marked by を, and 送ります is the main verb in the polite form (ます). The の links 結婚 (wedding) to お祝い, forming 'gift of/for a wedding'. The subject (I) is implicit, as is common in Japanese.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: A estrutura é [objeto] を [verbo]: 結婚のお祝い (presente de casamento) é o objeto direto marcado por を, e 送ります é o verbo principal na forma polida (ます). O の liga 結婚 (casamento) a お祝い, formando 'presente de/para casamento'. O sujeito (eu) está implícito, como é comum em japonês.

translation_literal.pt-BR: Quanto ao presente de casamento, (eu o) envio.

translation.en: I'm going to send a wedding gift.
translation.pt-BR: Vou mandar um presente de casamento.

before.jp: 太いうどんが好きです
before.kana: ふというどんがすきです

structure_explanation.en: 太い ('thick') qualifies うどん directly (太いうどん = 'thick udon'). The particle が marks the object of the liking, since with 好き what is liked is marked by が, not by を. The predicate 好きです is the な-adjective 好き plus polite です. The vocabulary focus is 太い (thick).
structure_explanation.pt-BR: 太い ('grosso') qualifica うどん diretamente (太いうどん = 'udon grosso'). A partícula が marca o objeto do gosto, pois com 好き o que se gosta é marcado por が, não por を. O predicado 好きです é o adjetivo な 好き mais です educado. O foco de vocabulário é 太い (grosso).
